title: Quest
body:
Listen Dummy...
If you want me to accompany you thorough this journey, Fetch me the sapphire pendant from the Manor 
Go through the portal over there, it should get you near the pendant
And if you ever get the pendant, come through the same portal you got there
Pay attention. I wont repeat it again.
This may be a little challenging considering....
Well... You.
But you'll get it
I believe in you
Now shoo, Go away
